title: FATHER GOD, I WELCOME YOUR PRESENCE INTO MY DAY
text: Beloved, I want you to understand something that will revolutionize your entire [music] existence. When you wake up in the morning, what happens in the first 30 minutes of your day will determine the atmosphere that follows you for the next 24 hours. This is not motivational speech. This is a spiritual principle that has been tried and tested by men and women who walk with God across [music] generations. The scripture says in Psalm 5:3, "My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up." There is something prophetic [music] about the morning hour. There is something strategic about what you do when you open your eyes. Now listen to me very carefully. The presence of God is not an abstract concept [music] that we discuss in theological seminaries. The presence of God is the most tangible reality available to [music] the believer. When Moses encountered the presence of God at the burning bush, it was not a philosophical discussion. When Isaiah saw the Lord high and lifted up in the temple, it was not theoretical [music] knowledge. When the disciples walked with Jesus for 3 and 1/2 years, they were not walking with an ideology. [music] They were walking with the embodied presence of the almighty God. And the same reality that they experience is available to you and me today [music] through the person of the Holy Spirit. The question I want to ask you today is this. Are you deliberately and intentionally welcoming the presence of God into your day [music] or are you just hoping that somehow you will stumble into divine favor? You see, there is a difference between [music] assumption and invitation. Many believers assume that because they are saved, the presence of God automatically follows them everywhere. But I want to show you from scripture that there is a protocol for hosting the presence of God. There is a culture that attracts his presence. There is a lifestyle that makes you a candidate for sustained divine companionship. When you look at the tabernacle of Moses, you discover that there were different courts. There was the outer court where [music] anyone could come. There was the inner court where only the priest could minister [music] and there was the most holy place where only the high priest could enter once a year. You and I have been given [music] access by the blood of Jesus to come boldly to the throne of grace. Hebrews 10:19 says, "Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus." This is not presumption. This is your covenant right. But [music] even though access has been granted, there must be a hunger that drives you into that place of intimacy. God is looking for worshippers. He's looking for people who will not just come to him when they need something, but people who will come to him because they understand that without [music] his presence, nothing else matters. You can have all the money in the world. You can have [music] influence, you can have education, you can have connections, but if the presence of God is not with you, you are just [music] a sophisticated orphan navigating through life without divine backing. You are about to become so sensitive [music] to the Holy Spirit that you will know when he's pleased and when he's grieved. You will know when he's leading you to go and when he's cautioning [music] you to wait. You will know when he's saying yes and when he's saying no. This is not mysticism. This is the normal Christian life that Jesus died to give us. Now when I say Lord I welcome your presence [music] into my day. I am not speaking empty words. I am engaging in a prophetic declaration that aligns my spirit with the frequency of heaven. Words are seeds. Words are containers of power. The Bible says in Proverbs 18:21, "Death and life are in the power of the [music] tongue. The roads are cleaned, the security is tightened, the protocols are reviewed. Nobody [music] just wakes up and receives a king without preparation. In the same way, when you welcome the presence of God into your day, you are [music] saying, "Lord, I have prepared my heart. I have sanctified my thoughts. I have set my affections on things above. Come and take your rightful place in my day." There are dimensions of God's presence that many believers have never experienced because they have never created room for him. Jesus said in Revelation 3:20, "Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If any man hear my voice and open the door, I will come into him and will suck with him [music] and he with me." Notice that Jesus is knocking, but he will not force [music] his way in. He waits for you to open the door. He waits for you to say come in Lord you are welcome here. Some of you have been struggling with anxiety, struggling with fear, struggling [music] with confusion. And the reason is simple. You have been trying to navigate through life without consciously acknowledging the presence of God. You wake up, [music] check your phone, scroll through social media, rush into your day, and then wonder why everything feels so heavy and burdensome. Suddenly you have [music] strength in the midst of weakness. David understood this principle. That is why [music] he said in Psalm 16 to8, I have set the Lord always before me because he's at my right hand. I shall not be moved.
